name: finalize the game session before saving the map
definition: exit the maze interpreter before creating the map so the saved map reflects the finalized grid.
failure_mode: an un-exited session or stale map is what gets compared

name: generate python bindings from a proto file
definition: run the code generator to produce the two python binding modules into the target directory
failure_mode: bindings generated elsewhere or not at all break both the file and import checks

name: graph/state-space search (BFS by depth/frontier, single-piece move chains) to a goal
definition: Explore a state graph (sliding-tile BFS with per-depth/disjoint layers, single-piece move chains to a goal) ensuring uniqueness and reachability.
failure_mode: Non-BFS or incomplete exploration fails the frontier equality check.

name: handle a large combinatorial subset search over a wide variable space correctly
definition: Combinatorially iterate over many variable-combination subsets and count distinct feasible corner points without duplicates or misses.
